schemas.query: select nspname as name from pg_namespace where nspname not like 'pg_%' and nspname <> 'information_schema' order by 1

tables.query: select c.relname as name, c.relkind as kind, c.relrowsecurity as rls, pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) as owner from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind in ('r','p') order by 1

columns.query: select c.relname as table_name, a.attname as name, format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) as type, a.attnotnull as not_null, a.attidentity as identity, a.attgenerated as generated, pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) as default_expression, coll.collname as collation from pg_attribute a join pg_class c on c.oid=a.attrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace left join pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid=c.oid and d.adnum=a.attnum left join pg_collation coll on coll.oid=a.attcollation where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind in ('r','p') and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped order by 1,a.attnum

enums.query: select t.typname as name, e.enumlabel as label, e.enumsortorder as sort_order from pg_type t join pg_enum e on e.enumtypid=t.oid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=t.typnamespace where n.nspname='public' order by 1,3

constraints.query: select c.conrelid::regclass::text as table_name, c.conname as name, c.contype as kind, c.condeferrable as deferrable, c.convalidated as validated, pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid,true) as definition from pg_constraint c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.connamespace where n.nspname='public' order by 1,2

indexes.query: select tablename as table_name, indexname as name, indexdef as definition from pg_indexes where schemaname='public' order by 1,2

sequences.query: select sequencename as name, data_type, start_value, min_value, max_value, increment_by, cycle, last_value from pg_sequences where schemaname='public' order by 1

views.query: select viewname as name, definition from pg_views where schemaname='public' order by 1

materialized_views.query: select matviewname as name, definition, ispopulated from pg_matviews where schemaname='public' order by 1

functions_procedures.query: select p.proname as name, p.prokind as kind, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as arguments, pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) as definition from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.prokind in ('f','p') order by 1,3

triggers.query: select c.relname as table_name, t.tgname as name, pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) as definition from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and not t.tgisinternal order by 1,2

rls_policies.query: select schemaname, tablename as table_name, policyname as name, permissive, roles, cmd, qual, with_check from pg_policies where schemaname='public' order by 2,3

grants.query: select table_name, grantee, privilege_type, is_grantable from information_schema.table_privileges where table_schema='public' order by 1,2,3

extensions.query: select extname as name, extversion as version from pg_extension order by 1

environment.query: select current_setting('server_version') as engine_version, current_setting('TimeZone') as timezone, datcollate as collation, datctype as character_class from pg_database where datname=current_database()

schemas.query: select nspname as name from pg_namespace where nspname not like 'pg_%' and nspname <> 'information_schema' order by 1

tables.query: select c.relname as name, c.relkind as kind, c.relrowsecurity as rls, pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) as owner from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind in ('r','p') order by 1

columns.query: select c.relname as table_name, a.attname as name, format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) as type, a.attnotnull as not_null, a.attidentity as identity, a.attgenerated as generated, pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) as default_expression, coll.collname as collation from pg_attribute a join pg_class c on c.oid=a.attrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace left join pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid=c.oid and d.adnum=a.attnum left join pg_collation coll on coll.oid=a.attcollation where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind in ('r','p') and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped order by 1,a.attnum

enums.query: select t.typname as name, e.enumlabel as label, e.enumsortorder as sort_order from pg_type t join pg_enum e on e.enumtypid=t.oid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=t.typnamespace where n.nspname='public' order by 1,3

indexes.query: select tablename as table_name, indexname as name, indexdef as definition from pg_indexes where schemaname='public' order by 1,2

sequences.query: select sequencename as name, data_type, start_value, min_value, max_value, increment_by, cycle, last_value from pg_sequences where schemaname='public' order by 1

functions_procedures.name: dictionary_immutable_registry
functions_procedures.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dictionary_immutable_registry()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF OLD.state = 'validated' AND (TG_OP = 'DELETE' OR
   ROW(NEW.id,NEW.base_release_id,NEW.state,NEW.manifest,NEW.manifest_sha,NEW.validated_at)
   IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id,OLD.base_release_id,OLD.state,OLD.manifest,OLD.manifest_sha,OLD.validated_at)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable_dictionary_registry';
 END IF;
 RETURN CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN OLD ELSE NEW END;
END $function$
